_comment: The config `typecheck` runs, as distinct from the one `build` runs.
A package's tsconfig.json excludes `**/*.test.ts` because tests must not land in dist.
That exclusion also meant nothing ever typechecked them: vitest transpiles without checking, so a
test double that no longer satisfied an interface failed at runtime instead of at build — and a
deliberate catch could swallow the TypeError, leaving a green suite over an unexercised path.
A package extends this from its own tsconfig.typecheck.json, which re-includes the tests.
Emit is off here, so the declaration/sourceMap settings the build needs would only be noise.
